key_learning_outcomes.label: C
items: Students analyze how setting shapes character and plot, compare themes, explain unreliable narrators and shifts in point of view, and analyze poetic forms.
Students explain how informational sections and features convey purpose, compare central ideas, explain how diction and syntax achieve purpose, and track arguments and reasoning.
Students analyze figurative language and allusions, paraphrase grade-level texts, compare authors with differing perspectives, and explain rhetorical devices.
Students write narratives, claims that acknowledge a counterclaim, and expository texts, follow grade-level conventions, research with multiple sources, and present orally.
Students use academic vocabulary, Greek and Latin roots and affixes, and context to determine connotative and denotative meanings, and use digital tools and media.

version_and_update_notes.standards_version: Florida's State Academic Standards (B.E.S.T.) English Language Arts, 2025
notes: Organization: by_grade (ELA.7 codes). The book introduces a 6th-8th grade band, but these benchmarks are grade 7, not a named course.
Benchmark statements extracted from the rule-adopted 2025 PDF (Ref-18865), printed pages 86-90. Clarifications, sample texts, and convention skill lists are not stored in standard text.
No foundational-reading benchmarks (ELA.7.F) are printed for grade 7. ELA.7.C.1.1 is not in the grade 7 list; writing benchmarks start at ELA.7.C.1.2.
